text_block_list.text: Late December—
Soon, the Arima Kinen will begin.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work today as 
well.

Devoting days to tireless effort, just to 
repay those who light the lanterns, even a 
little—

The days continued to pass in quiet 
succession, simply heading toward the end.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
... Would you like to take a break and go 
see the night view?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Tran-san told me the other day. 
Apparently, you can see a wonderful view 
from the hill at this time of year.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...It's quite cold, isn't it? According to 
Tran-san, it should be in this direction.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —My... it truly is... beautiful.

The entire town gave off a gentle 
radiance. Christmas light displays, the 
neon glow of buildings. Light spilling 
from the windows of houses. And—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...? Oh my, all those... lots of lights—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...A lan... tern... is it?

Far more lights than I had ever seen 
before shone from each and every window in 
the neighborhood.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Well—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
So many people... Every single night, 
night after night——to me...?

text_block_list.name: Local Resident C
text_block_list.text:
I light the lantern every night, too. 
Because I don't ever want to forget what 
you gave me.

text_block_list.name: Local Resident C
text_block_list.text:
And... with the wish that you might run 
again someday. I poured those feelings 
into it too...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...If only I could return to how I felt 
before.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I have never felt so strongly about 
anything in my life.

—That night, Victoire Pisa hosted a brief 
livestream for her fans.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...From each and every one of those 
lights, I could feel such warm emotions."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. That is precisely why... I felt 
I had to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I suppose I can never go back to feeling 
the way I used to.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
In the near future, the day might come 
when I gaze upon this dazzling racing 
world from the outside.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...However, I have accomplished what 
needed to be done. Therefore, I have no 
regrets.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
What I received today, feeling that 
scenery.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And... something I might have been able to 
give.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I will never forget that.

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
""Thank you as well." "I'm so glad the 
light reached you." "Thank you, Victoire 
Pisa.""

text_block_list.name: Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, no matter what, I really want 
you to be here with me."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem quite as simple as calling 
it a mere "slump," though.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If we can be of any help, we'd be glad to 
lend a hand anytime.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, perhaps running together again will 
give us a clue.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
You who have "surpassed" "XACF"— You 
are... the "Alpha Star."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: "I" 'pray'... For your 'future'—"HPNS."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I put together a quick list of some 
training methods that look pretty good. 
...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sorry if this is a bother. It's just... I 
felt lonely after all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...*sniff* I'm sorry... Your feelings are 
what matter most, Pisa-san.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Still, but still... I really, really want 
us to stay together...!

Time marched on relentlessly— and the day 
before the Arima Kinen arrived.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Learning what warmth was, longing for it, 
and dedicating my life to it made those 
days painful, yet full of happiness.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: And yet—my heart remains serene.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps there was never anything that 
could truly replace what once drove me 
forward."

"Tomorrow is her last race— Tormented by a 
sense of helplessness from having achieved 
nothing, I fell into a light slumber."
—It was late at night, 2:30 AM.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry for bothering you so late. 
Um...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: The lanterns are...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"It seems that, across the world right 
now, lights are beginning to kindle."

Still not fully understanding the 
situation, I open the live-streamed 
UmaTube video she told me about.

Racecourses from all around the world 
flashing onto the screen one after another 
were—

In each of them, lanterns casting a soft 
light were lit, glowing with a faint 
orange hue.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I only found out after an old friend 
contacted me, too. And so— It's 9:30 PM in 
Dubai right now. Most likely...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
No, surely it represents the post time of 
the race in Dubai.

The live stream cameras switched one after 
another. People were leaving their 
messages in turns.

text_block_list.name: Local A
text_block_list.text:
“Your race in Dubai moved my heart. Thank 
you for something so wonderful.”

text_block_list.name: French Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "No one will ever forget your brilliance."

text_block_list.name: Foreign Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"It reminded me once again that racing 
truly has power."

text_block_list.name: Man B
text_block_list.text:
"My heart was saved by watching you run. 
...Thank you, thank you so much!"

Cheers in every language were being sent 
to her, one after another.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I truly believed…… that what happened that 
day would just be forgotten with time……

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
However, even now... there are still so 
many... so many people—
choice_data_list:
I haven't forgotten how you ran for 
someone else's sake.

I haven't forgotten how you ran for 
someone else's sake.

text_block_list.text:
Surprisingly, the cheers of support for 
her didn't end there.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I... ngh, I don't want you to leave the 
racetrack, Pisa-san!

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Me too! After all, I started racing 
because I wanted to be just like Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Teacher
text_block_list.text:
I often watched you working hard at the 
academy from afar. Seeing you reach out to 
various girls, inviting them to train 
together...

text_block_list.name: Tracen Instructor
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why... today really does 
feel lonely after all.

text_block_list.name: Team Japan
text_block_list.text:
"I have never been more certain that there 
is power in racing than on that day. To 
have fought alongside you is the pride of 
my life."

text_block_list.name: URA Staff
text_block_list.text:
...I didn't want today to come. I wanted 
you to stay in the racing world... a 
little longer.

text_block_list.name: Media Representative A
text_block_list.text:
We're all still wearing the charms you 
gave us. So let's keep fighting together, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Media Representative A
text_block_list.text:
I will deliver another incredible race to 
the whole world that will go down in 
racing history...!
Countless hands reached out to her.

"I'll be lonely without you." "I want you 
to be in this world too."
Along with words expressing care for her—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, I... I am—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I have done... what needed to be done. 
Nothing can change that..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I can already... see my limits...! I was 
planning—on ending it all at the Arima 
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"And yet right now... my heart is 
trembling so uncontrollably—!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I want to return to that circle...!

I hold out my hand. Though hesitant, she 
placed her palm over mine.
choice_data_list: In that case, let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I just... gh, can't run like I 
used to anymore—”
choice_data_list:
It's okay. So let's go back. Back into 
that circle

text_block_list.text:
Even if the fire she once had has gone 
out, with who she is now, she can power 
right through to the end.

Those eyes shone brightly enough... to 
instill complete conviction.
choice_data_list:
Because right now, you're filled with 
hope.

Because right now, you're filled with 
hope.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...gh— So this... is hope...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Following this heart of mine—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I will go run my heart out...! Across 
that warm, welcoming racetrack!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix that crowns the year, the 
Arima Kinen! All eyes are naturally on the 
next-generation leader, the Classic Triple 
Crown Umamusume, Orfevre—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"The world was truly filled with the 
glorious radiance of Orfevre."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall not allow anyone to cast a shadow 
over it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...You're late.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Last night's lantern was truly a wild 
card. Will it lead her to revival, or...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Let us believe. In her heart.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: H-Huh—?!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Thank you for waiting...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I am so sorry. For being late—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...Pisa, you're—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Rose, everyone... ...I'm sorry for making 
you worry. I'm completely fine now.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Today... I will run with all my might 
alongside everyone.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ――"Victoire Pisa."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. I heard your wings were torn 
away, but was it merely idle chatter?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(I still don't know either. Just how far 
the current me can go.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(And yet... I can feel it. The warmth in 
my body. The surge of power...!)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
These new wings of the heart... they 
surely only just sprouted. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I will achieve it, no matter what...! 
Victory will be mine!
